record.original_question: What general structure results can be proved for smooth projective varieties with pseudo-effective anti-canonical divisor?

evidence.quote: As explained in Section 4, the structure theorem for nef tangent bundles in [DPS94] is partially generalized to pseudo-effective tangent bundles. In the same spirit, it is natural and of interest to ask the following problem:
Proposition 5.3. What can we say for (smooth) projective varieties with pseudo-effective anti-canonical divisor?

artifact.self_contained_problem: Let $X$ be a smooth projective variety over $\mathbb{C}$ whose anti-canonical divisor $-K_X$ is pseudo-effective (i.e., the numerical class of $-K_X$ lies in the closure of the cone generated by classes of effective $\mathbb{R}$-divisors). Establish general structure results describing the geometry of such $X$. In particular, determine whether there exists a canonical fibration $f \colon X \to Y$ (for instance an MRC-type or Albanese-type fibration), describe the structure of its general fibres and of the base $Y$ (e.g. rational connectedness of fibres, numerical/positivity properties of $K_Y$ or of the tangent bundle of $Y$), and decide to what extent the known structure theorems for projective manifolds with nef anti-canonical divisor (such as the splitting of an étale cover into a product of a rationally connected manifold and a manifold with numerically trivial canonical bundle) extend to the pseudo-effective setting.
artifact.status_search_result: Structure theorems are well established in the nef anti-canonical case (Cao; Cao–Höring; and extensions to klt pairs by Cao–Höring and others, e.g. arXiv:2105.14308). For the strictly pseudo-effective anti-canonical setting, only partial structure results are known (e.g. via MRC fibrations, Albanese maps, and results on pseudo-effective tangent bundles), but a complete general structure theorem comparable to the nef case has not been established.

status_evidence.title: Structure theorem for projective klt pairs with nef anti-canonical divisor
status_evidence.snippet: Structure theorem for projective klt pairs (X,Δ) with nef anti-log canonical divisor, generalizing Cao and Cao–Höring's results in the smooth case.
status_evidence.claim: Structure theorems exist in the nef anti-canonical case and have been extended to klt pairs.

status_evidence.title: Structure of projective varieties with nef anticanonical divisor (log terminal singularities case)
status_evidence.snippet: Structure results for varieties with nef anticanonical divisor under log terminal singularities.
status_evidence.claim: The nef anti-canonical case admits a fairly complete structure theory.

status_evidence.title: On projective manifolds with pseudo-effective tangent bundle
status_evidence.snippet: Projective manifold X with pseudo-effective tangent bundle admits a smooth fibration X→Y to a flat manifold Y with rationally connected general fibre.
status_evidence.claim: Partial structure results exist in the pseudo-effective tangent bundle setting, related to but stronger than pseudo-effective anti-canonical.
